final_message:
All tests are now passing. The issue was that pytest was using a cached version of `slugify.py` from the `build/lib/src/` directory which had an incorrect regex pattern (`r"[^a-z0-9]"` instead of `r"[^a-z0-9]+"`). After removing the cache and build directory, the tests now use the correct implementation from `src/slugify.py`.

The fix was to update the source file `src/slugify.py` to use `r"[^a-z0-9]+"` (one or more non-alphanumeric characters) instead of `r"[^a-z0-9]"` (single character), which properly handles consecutive spaces and punctuation.
